Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2144 of 2022

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Its Secy. Deptt. Of Home Affairs Secr Lko.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And 3 O
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Pratap Singh,Karun Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Diwakar Shukla,Gyanoday Shukla
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.

The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime No.1002/2020, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 504, 506, 120-B of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Pratapgarh.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel appearing on behalf of complainant.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent, she has been falsely implicated due to village enmity; she is the mother of the accused.
As per the prosecution case, prosecutrix gone somewhere without informing her parents on 16.10.2020 she is recovered on 17.10.2020 by the police.

According to supurdginama she has not stated anything against the applicant rather she has stated that she went away from her home as she was angry from the complainant and stated that she Smt. Devlahin @ Savitri Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru.

1 will not repeat this again.
The supurdginam is of 17.10.2020.
After ten days of the supurdginama the F.I.R. has been lodged on 29.10.2020 making frivolous allegations against the co-accused persons as well as the present applicant.

It is submitted that even as per the statement of the prosecutrix under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and Section 164 Cr.P.C. the applicant is said to have assisted the accused persons and sent her to their elder son Deepak.
Applicant has no criminal antecedents.
Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that she will cooperate in the investigation.
Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for complainant have opposed the bail prayer.
Learned counsel for complainant has submitted that prosecutrix in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and Section 164 Cr.P.C. has supported prosecution case.
However, could not dispute the fact that only allegations against the present applicant is that she has assisted the main accused in the offence.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and considering the fact that applicant is a lady; the investigation for the present applicant is still pending; she has no criminal antecedents;
counsel for applicant further undertakes that she shall co-operate in the trial; it would be expedient in the interest of justice that the liberty of the applicant may be protected till filing of police report u/s 173(2) Cr.P.C in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the applicant-Smt. Devlahin @ Savitri Devi shall be released on anticipatory bail in the aforesaid Case Crime number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/investigating officer/S.H.O. concerned with the following conditions:-
(1) The applicant shall cooperate in the investigation and she will not influence the witnesses.
(2) The accused-applicant will remain present as and when the arresting officer/1.O./S.H.O. concerned call (s) for investigation/interrogation.
(3) The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.
(4) In case of default, it would be open for the investigating agency to move application for vacation of this interim protection.
The application stands allowed.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Saurabh Yadav/-
